verdict.rationale: kitty documents a remote-control interface for scripts and the shell: opening windows, sending text, changing titles, and more. A hands-on probe confirmed a complete external agent loop over a socket: `kitten @ ls` returned window and tab state as JSON, then send-text, get-text and close-window all worked against a live window. Missing for 10: the pack does not cite the underlying wire-protocol documentation itself, and there is no machine-readable spec or llms.txt (both probes returned 404), though OpenAPI matters little for a local terminal.
